raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / NUOVO TRILOCALE CON GIARDINO ESCLUSIVO | RESIDENCE ALTANEA A CAORLE NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Nuovo Trilocale con Giardino Esclusivo | Residence Altanea a Caorle PORTO SANTA MARGHERITA · CAORLE · VENEZIA PRICE €418,000 Photos (19) Floor plans (1) 1 / 19 FLOOR AREA 104 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Caorle! Just a few steps from the beach of Lido Altanea in Caorle, this first-floor apartment has a decidedly unconventional personality. Instead of the usual standard view, it offers architecture designed for those who love outdoor living without sacrificing the privacy of an upper floor. It all begins on the ground floor with a private garden of about 60 sqm: not just a simple patch of green, but an exclusive space where you can place a gazebo or unwind after returning from the beach. From here, an external staircase leads directly to the first floor. Before entering, you are welcomed by a livable terrace that transforms the concept of landing into a true outdoor space, perfect for summer dinners or refreshing aperitifs. The interior opens onto an open-plan living area smartly designed to combine kitchen and living room in one unique, bright and well-proportioned environment. Beyond the living area, a central hallway organizes connections throughout the house. Immediately at the beginning is a first bathroom located strategically to serve both daily needs in the day zone and guests' visits. Continuing on are two bedrooms: one double bedroom featuring its own small private terrace and one spacious master bedroom that boasts direct access to and connection with the main terrace adjoining the living area. Finally, more secluded and reserved is another bathroom accessible further down. Completing this property are a convenient reserved parking spot and access to the beautiful swimming pool within residence grounds—all set within meticulously maintained surroundings. The site is already available for viewing by appointment: it's a unique opportunity to see firsthand what’s being built while starting to envision your new life by sea. Contact us for availability details, floor plans and specifications.
